template.name: Weekly Rebound Corridor
template.entry_long: open - close / ({p0} + roc(close, {p1}) / {p0}) > {p1} * atr(high, low, close, {p2}) and close > open
template.notes: The prior close is reconstructed as close/(1+roc(close,1)/100), so the entry is a gap from the previous session close wider than 0.5 ATR(14) with a positive completed candle, an explicit corridor proxy for the 10-point gap. The 5-point take-profit, 49-point stop, Friday-only gate, and forced pre-session close are not percentage/DSL fields.
